title: Compatible-tuples construction for module-sheaf gluing
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-site-module-sheaf-gluing, the compatible-tuples construction produces a module sheaf F, local module morphisms e and inverse morphisms e_inv, with e_inv i ≫ e i = 𝟙 and e i ≫ e_inv i = 𝟙, and the required overlap compatibility.

source.place: Tag 04TR, construction of the glued sheaf from compatible tuples and verification of local graph inverses.

proof.text: For each object over U define sections as compatible tuples; give restrictions and module operations componentwise. Glue each component along a covering to prove the tuple presheaf is a sheaf. Define e by graph evaluation and e_inv by transition maps; naturality and the cocycle prove both inverse equations and overlap compatibility.
